_about: W-analysis store: one record per 2019 federal polling place keyed to the four SEIFA 2016 indexes (irsd/irsad/ier/ieo scores + national deciles) via the SA1 (ASGS 2016) polygon containing the booth's premises coordinates. The area is the area OF THE PREMISES — a geographic proxy for the catchment's SES, not an aggregate of catchment voters; compare across census vintages by decile only. Coordinate-less mobile/hospital teams carry note=noCoords; cube-suppressed areas carry note=seifaSuppressed with seifa:null. stateFlag is a guard report only; the physical premises location wins.
